text: Artificial intelligence is quickly changing the modern workplace. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, from sorting emails to managing schedules, which saves employees valuable time. AI-powered productivity tools help workers organise projects, analyse data, and make faster decisions. Rather than replacing people completely, AI often works alongside humans, combining machine speed with human judgement and creativity. This is called human-AI collaboration. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, and many existing jobs require new digital skills. For this reason, continuous learning and adaptability are becoming essential for anyone who wants to succeed in tomorrow's workplace.
